title: H10: Mean-one fast-case weights under a fixed cumulative error guard
question: Can controlling total fitting weight restore overall accuracy while retaining most of the H9 fast-wind benefit?
hypothesis: Mean-one normalized fast-case weights will produce a training-CV forecast with overall RMSE at most 1% above the original wind-only anchor, and fast500 RMSE at most 2% above the H9 fast-wind specialist. This is a constrained trade-off hypothesis, not a claim of further fast-wind improvement.
method: Use only the exact isolated original Folds 1–4 bundle, the same four grouped inner splits, fitting offsets 6–18 and validation offsets 6–19. Purge entire fitting blocks sharing validation target dates and mask inner-validation-source wind/EVE values before fitting. Mirror all 36 H9 recipes: four feature groups (wind only, +18 ESP, +44 EUV-line, +62 all-EVE features); each learner pair is 25% ridge alpha1000 and 75% HGB (150 iterations, learning rate .05, 7 leaves, minimum leaf30, L2=10, seed2026). For fitting targets >=500 km/s set raw relative weights m in {1,2,4}, otherwise 1; divide the weights by their fitting-split mean. Explicit imputation/scaling remains unweighted. HGB weights also affect internal histogram bins; the change controls total weight mass and effective regularization, not a pure loss-only intervention. For each group retain three weighted/unweighted pairs and .25/.50/.75 mixtures of each weighted pair with its unweighted pair, nine forecasts per group. Require unweighted all-EVE to reproduce the recorded H8 selected prediction within 1e-8 km/s before selecting. Compare normalized recipes with their frozen literal-weight H9 counterparts. Fixed cumulative overall anchor: H8 starting wind-only RMSE80.72360614459454. Fast reference: H9 selected RMSE123.90929011714888 on observed >=500. Eligible iff overall<=1.01*overall anchor and fast500<=1.02*H9 fast reference. Minimize J=.5*MSEall/anchorMSE+.5*MSEfast/H9fastMSE; exact ties prefer fewer features/fewer fitted pairs. If none qualify, retain H9 as a clearly labelled fast-wind specialist that fails the cumulative overall guard. Report all 36 new forecasts and controls, matched normalization effects, fixed inclusive500/600 continuous and detection metrics, paired latest/27-day persistence skill and coverage, per-fold and duplicate-mean sensitivity. Secondary600 metrics cannot select or rescue the hypothesis.

Python3.12.9, numpy2.3.1, scipy1.16.1, sklearn1.9.1. Actual source and input hashes recorded before execution/output.
